profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer — Empowering AI Revenue Cycle Tools
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a leadership background, now focused on building. My strength is the human side of the work: leading and building software that's genuinely easy to use and meets or exceeds what product managers are after.
 
I'm deliberate about AI — excited by where it helps, careful about where it introduces weak code or hallucinations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Started by leading a team at R1 RCM to develop AI-driven coding management systems that enhance healthcare revenue cycle efficiency, using full-stack and cloud-based technologies to deliver high-quality software solutions.

With an exciting opportunity, I quickly returned to hands-on development to join a company-wide initiative leveraging AI within Palantir's Foundry environment.  On this project, I have:
 * Rapidly built and deployed solutions that validate AI model predictions using subject-matter-expert feedback.
 * Built a Quality Review application that audits 3% of all coders work, helping maintain a 95% coding accuracy standard.
 * Built an autonomous Coding Application that assists coders in generating billing codes for claims.

All three applications integrate AI feedback loops. After more than a decade in management, it's been energizing to get back into development and work alongside Claude and other AI agents for rapid software delivery.

positions.title: Associate Director, Software Engineering
positions.description:
In this role, I managed five engineering teams consisting of 38 engineers across multiple technology stacks, focusing on architecture design, refining engineering processes, cloud cost management, and effective feature planning.
Selected Achievements: 
• Delivered a 20% reduction in infrastructure costs and accelerated the time to market for new features by 40% by overseeing the transition to serverless architecture with Azure Functions.
• Enhanced customer satisfaction by launching a new UI team to decouple the UI from the backend, resulting in fast, dynamically loaded content and eliminating erratic long page load times.
• Increased software development velocity by 10% through the implementation of AI-driven Copilot and other AI tools to enhance development workflows.
• Successfully migrated 10 TB of data and 5 TB SQL databases for 10 major applications, supporting $200M in annual contracts, from on-premises data centers to the cloud.
• Improved disaster recovery times from days to hours and strengthened system security by partnering with the DevOps team to implement a hub-and-spoke architecture.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
At MCG Health, we improve patient outcomes and care for payers and providers. Our two products are leading the industry in improving patient care using evidence-based outcomes.
• Managed and mentored 23 employees across 3 teams responsible for $50M in annual revenue
• I emphasized software improvements in logging, alerts, new design patterns, performance testing, code quality metrics, and prioritizing security and pen test reports.  This led to a 50% decrease in time spent resolving customer escalations, freeing up resources for new development initiatives and contributing to a 30% increase in satisfaction levels among customers and employees
• Implemented code quality meetings, leading to better code reviews and team creativity
• Led efforts to drive innovation and development processes, improve team velocities, and reduce customer escalations before being promoted to Associate Director

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
At this company, I oversaw the efforts of two engineering teams of 11, ensuring effective collaboration with a 16-member offshore engineering team to enhance development and quality assurance processes.
Selected Achievements 
• Delivered 95% of product releases on schedule by utilizing strategic planning and diligent tracking of sprint progress.
• Contributed to preventing a potential $2M loss and substantial downtime by implementing a fail-safe solution, safeguarding client interests and ensuring system stability.
• Earned Circle of Excellence award for successfully delivering new security requirements to a key client ahead of schedule.
• Increased customer retention by leading the integration of LDAP SSO, facilitating essential federated login capabilities for clients.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Web Development · Software Management · Regression Testing · Coaching & Mentoring · JavaScript · Team Leadership · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · Data Analysis · Engineering Management · Software Engineering · Software Project Management · SDLC · .NET Architecture

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer / Manager
positions.description:
In this role, I created in-depth proposals for new software features and products, ensuring alignment with engineering teams on best practices and interview standards.

Selected Achievements:
• Reduced overnight ETL processing time by 33%, from nine hours to six hours, by leveraging data partitioning, index includes, and common table expressions.
• Enhanced the performance and stability of a large-scale application by 35% through targeted optimization, improved nightly ETL processes, and the integration of additional logging and alert mechanisms.
• Streamlined the HL7 processing service to efficiently handle over 500K daily alerts, resulting in improved response times and reliability.
• Delivered a 5% increase in annual contracts by overseeing the creation of a new Point-of-Care product, achieving extensive recognition and positive user feedback.
positions.insights: Skills: OLAP Cubes · Agile Methodologies · Software Management · Regression Testing · Coaching & Mentoring · Agile · Team Leadership · Management · C# · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Engineering Management · Software Engineering · Software Project Management · SDLC · .NET Architecture

positions.title: SDE / LEAD
positions.description:
•	Led a team of 5 engineers to develop a new product known as Xperts using Microsoft Azure.
•	Designed application around responsive design, consistency, and scalability. Xpert program is now known as the Ambassador program. https://ambassadors.microsoft.com/xbox
•	Guided team in developing a program that enabled Xbox owners to support other Xbox owners with questions and help through online chat and receive credits towards Xbox-related icons and status symbols.
•	Created Xperts chat window to tie into background services that would find Xpert based on positive ratings and previous answers to similar questions, the service would then use instant messenger SDK to link the chat to an Xpert online.
•	Enabled program to save results and survey scores to the database for reporting and usage, building a proof of concept from scratch and releasing the first successful prototype.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Agile Methodologies · Git · Regression Testing · Coaching & Mentoring · SQL · C# · Software Engineering · SDLC · .NET Architecture

positions.title: Web Developer Contract
positions.description: Built their scheduling website from the ground up to match the appropriate physician with their clients. Each stage is approved with proper notifications to all technicians and physicians. The website is built in ASP.NET C# AJAX and a SQL Server backend.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead developer for all internal and external software.  Utilizing .NET MVC, C#, Visual Basic, SQL Server, and ADO.NET.  An engineering firm based out of Houston, TX, that builds heat transfer equipment for large oil and gas operations.
•	Built a primary engineering library engine embedded into multiple applications, allowing customers to see how their product would perform in their plants. This helped increase sales from $20 million a year to over $50 million in five years.
•	Built application to design heat transfer equipment and generate CAD drawings and CNC software used to machine parts
•	Built applications for estimating and pricing, document control, mechanical ASME software, Tube Layouts, and Heat transfer parallel processing design output
•	Received Idea award for creating a scaled-down version of the heat transfer design program into a tool that sales engineers could use to quickly generate designs for estimating
positions.insights: Skills: Regression Testing · Software Engineering · SDLC · .NET Architecture
